name: Festo Virtual Labs
summary:
**Experience automation and mechatronics like never before with our XR-powered simulation.**

By using virtual automation components in a real-world environment, you can see what used to be impossible. Interact with valves, cylinders, tubes, manifolds and other components to understand their functions and how they work together in an integrated system.
With the connection to our FluidSIM simulation & interaction software we guarantee real-time simulation results for in-depth analysis and troubleshooting.
